issues.detail: Hebrew has קִרְיָתַיִם (Kiriathaim), but Chinese renders it as 基列亞音 (Gilead-jaam?), which is a different place name. The correct rendering should be 基列亞音 or 基列亞廷? Actually 基列亞音 is not the standard transliteration of קִרְיָתַיִם; it appears to be a swap with another name (possibly 基列亞巴 or similar). The Hebrew name is Kiriathaim, not Gilead-jaam.
